column1: # BENCH-SRC-0 manifest (2026-11-07). Suite = LAYER-TEST-0 r9: every program with an official
# OCaml source. Columns: name, official OCaml source URL, commit, source sha256, rsd path, rsd
# sha256, rscm path, rscm sha256, value-check status, reason. Each .rsd header also pins the
# secondary source it was ported from (koka .kk / Game rust) with its own recheck statement.
# The .rscm files are byte-identical to the EMITTER-4/census table (rscm_q column), so the
# S0-CLOSE-0/1/2 compiled-run evidence for those bytes carries over and is named where used.
# Drop note (r9, superseded): the 16 Bend bench/runtime candidates (HigherOrderCO/Bend
# be236f324ed0338fe907fe50474468e4d3b94157, pinned and triaged) had no official OCaml and were
# out of the r9 suite. Revision 2 (2026 11-07, LAYER-TEST-0 r11) returns the Bend 2 set: the
# 13 non-float programs below are ported as U32-model .rsd (departure SRC-BEND-U32 named in
# each header) with .rscm emitted here and checked against the pinned bend 2.0.40 binary's own
# output at the published input; kmeans/mandelbrot/nbody/raytrace are f32 (named, not ported).
# Nothing else was dropped: all eight r9 programs have official OCaml. closure_claim = 0.
# Status vocabulary: rsd:equal@input(value) = evalLean (evalSCM) on the RSCM emitted from the
# .rsd equals the suite's expected value at that input; rsd:stuck@input(name) = named refusal;
# rsd:unfinished@input(bound) = interpreted run killed at the bound, expected value from the
# suite files or the named lane report; rscm:compiled_equal@input(value, compiler) = the
# emitted .rscm compiled and run at that input with the named compiler; rscm:<named reason> =
# no completed compiled run at the smallest published input, reason named.
